crossRefs.note: and said, “Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.
Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect…

translations.web: The one woman said, “Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house. I delivered a child with her in the house.
translations.bsb: One woman said, “Please, my lord, this woman and I live in the same house, and I gave birth while she was in the house.
translations.kjv: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
translations.asv: And the one woman said, Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
